trending.name: lvgl

hidden_gems.name: QSetun
hidden_gems.author: Leonid Kulcha and Antigravity <216130664+Sollemdev@users.noreply.github.com>
hidden_gems.sentence: Integer-only signal intelligence engine using Brusentsov balanced ternary logic and cellular apoptosis.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Q-Setun is a lightweight, zero-malloc signal processing engine for microcontrollers. Replaces heavy floating-point neural networks for 1D threshold anomaly tasks with discrete balanced ternary {-1, 0, +1} phase-space attractors. High-frequency noise is automatically annihilated via cellular apoptosis (+1 + -1 = 0), yielding sub-microsecond latency, 100% integer arithmetic, and zero heap fragmentation on ESP32, STM32, and AVR.
